key_insight: This review maps bias in AI disease detection and highlights data diversity, explainability, and fairness-aware design as priorities for more equitable systems.
clinical_relevance: Bias in diagnostic AI may contribute to unequal performance across patient populations, making fairness evaluation important before clinical deployment.
method: Reviewed disease-detection AI literature using a stated 2015–2026 study window.
Categorized approaches by input data, model architecture, and bias type.
Examined algorithmic, demographic, model, and deployment bias.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports reviewing 23 articles from 64,389 records across seven digital libraries, without quantitative estimates of bias reduction or diagnostic performance.
watch_item: The review identifies research priorities but does not establish that any mitigation strategy reliably improves fairness in clinical practice.
paper_title: Fairness or Fallacy? Mapping the Landscape of AI Bias in Disease Detection
